start: Staff & sign-in, signed in as owner

user_sees: Sheet 'Add a person' with 'Name', 'Mobile number' (+91) and 'What is their job?' set to 'Staff (front desk)'
'Adds members, collects fees and checks members in. Never sees money totals.'
must_not: 'Owner' chosen by default

steps.action: Type the name and the mobile number, tap 'Add'
user_sees: 'Adding…'
Toast '<name> added. Now make a sign-in code for them.'
A new row: pill 'Staff', 'Not signed in yet'
must_not: Two rows for one tap
A message sent to the person
The person able to sign in before a code is made

steps.action: Open Today and look at the Get started step 'Add your staff and trainers'
user_sees: The step is ticked
must_not: The step ticked when the add failed

start: Add a person with the job 'Owner'

user_sees: 'Can do everything, including money totals.' (with branches: 'Can do everything in every branch, including money totals.')
must_not: No word that this gives full rights

user_sees: A new row with the pill 'Owner'
must_not: The new owner able to remove the first owner without the at-least-one-owner rule

start: Add a person with the job 'Trainer'

steps.action: Pick 'Trainer', type name and number, tap 'Add'
user_sees: 'Same access as the front desk, plus the workout progress of the members you give them.'
Toast '<name> added. Now make a sign-in code for them.'
Row pill 'Trainer'
must_not: Owner rights

start: Add a person with the job 'Other'

user_sees: A box 'Type the job (for example Manager, Cleaner)'
'Same access as the front desk. The job only shows next to their name.'
must_not: The job box shown for the other choices

user_sees: Row pill 'Manager'
must_not: More rights than the front desk
More than 40 letters taken without a word

start: Add a person with wrong input

user_sees: 'Type their name.'
must_not: A person with no name

user_sees: 'Type a 10-digit mobile number, like 98290 12345.'
must_not: Anything sent

steps.action: Pick 'Other', leave the job empty, tap 'Add'
user_sees: Under the job box: 'Type their job, like Manager or Cleaner.'
must_not: The person added as plain staff without a word

steps.action: Type a number that is already on the list
user_sees: 'This mobile number is already on the list.'
must_not: A second row for the same number

steps.action: With branches: add as Owner a number that is staff at another branch
user_sees: 'This mobile number is on another branch’s staff list. Remove it there first, then add them as an owner.'
must_not: The person made an owner of every branch

start: A person is added, removed and added again; and an add that only half works

steps.action: Add a person, tap 'Remove' on the row, confirm
user_sees: Sheet 'Remove <name>?' with '<name> is signed out of every phone and computer. They can’t sign in again. Your members and payments stay as they are.'
Toast '<name> removed.'
must_not: Receipts taken by that person losing the name

steps.action: Add the same mobile number again
user_sees: A fresh row, not signed in, no PIN
must_not: The old PIN working again
'This mobile number is already on the list.' for a removed person

steps.action: Add a person as 'Trainer' while the trainer mark cannot be saved
user_sees: Toast '<name> added with front desk access, but not marked as a trainer yet. Tick Trainer on their row.'
must_not: The words pointing to a tick that this gym’s page does not show

user_sees: The list unchanged
must_not: A half-saved person

start: Who learns what when a person is added

user_sees: The row with their number, seen by owners only
must_not: The number shown to other staff
A WhatsApp or SMS sent by itself

steps.action: The new person tries Sign in with the number and no code
user_sees: 'That PIN or code is wrong, or the code has expired. Ask the gym owner for a new code. If you are the owner, make one on a device where you are signed in.'
must_not: The gym opening before the owner gives a code
